name: ghostsplit-twitch-chat-chromium-extension
description: Chromium extension (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera / Vivaldi) that restyles native twitch.tv chat to match the GhostSplit chat look. Replaces image badges with text pills (SUB/MOD/VIP/etc.), softens username colors, and works alongside 7TV / BetterTTV / FrankerFaceZ.
author: Facilitra

scripts.prelint: node -e "try{require('fs').accessSync('../sync-content.mjs')}catch{process.exit(0)};const r=require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,['../sync-content.mjs','--check'],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status){console.error('content drift detected — run npm run sync in either repo');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir ./dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files "scripts" "scripts/**" "dist" "dist/**" ".github" ".github/**" package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE .gitignore
